title: Minecarts
blurb: Rail-riding vehicles for transport, storage, and utility. Five variants can be crafted from an ordinary minecart and an installed block; spawner and command block minecarts are creative-only.
note: Tier C list rule covering all 7 minecart items. No item tag covers minecart variants (#minecraft:furnace_minecart_fuel covers furnace fuel, not carts). Spawner and command block minecarts have no recipe and are creative-only, but are included so the collection presents the complete set of minecart items. Guarded by tests/test_collections_drift.py. Icon borrowed from Minecart.
